items.title: Scout
items.text: Scout: You may do the Recon action in a city that does not contain a supply center.

mechanics.effect: You may do the Recon action in a city that does not contain a supply center.
mechanics.printedCapitalization: supply center is lowercase on the sticker

items.title: Smuggler
items.text: Smuggler: As an action, discard a City card to take a Supply cube from the reserve and put it in the city matching the card.

mechanics.effect: Discard a City card to take a Supply cube from the reserve and put it in the city matching the card.
restrictions: The cube comes from the reserve
The city must match the discarded City card

items.title: Lookout
items.text: Lookout: To do the Search action, you may take the City card matching your current city from the discard pile, add it to your hand, then search it once.

mechanics.effect: Take the City card matching your current city from the discard pile, add it to your hand, then search it once.
restrictions: The City card must match your current city
The card comes from the discard pile

items.title: CHARACTER ABILITIES
items.text:
CHARACTER ABILITIES
Add these to your pool of character abilities.

Lookout: To do the Search action, you may take the City card matching your current city from the discard pile, add it to your hand, then search it once. (2)

Scout: You may do the Recon action in a city that does not contain a supply center. (2)

Smuggler: As an action, discard a City card to take a Supply cube from the reserve and put it in the city matching the card. (1)

mechanics.effect: Add these stickers to the pool of character abilities.

summary: Three character abilities and the pool card that prices them. Lookout 2, Scout 2, Smuggler 1. Scout prints "supply center" in lowercase. Lookout says "the discard pile", not "Player discard pile". Corner badge on the pool card is 31.
